rule: A claimant's tier is the rank, within its river system, of the decree year of its most senior decreed water right on its official paths (Utah Division of Water Rights, points of diversion, decree records). River systems: the Little Bear River (South Fork, East Fork, main stem; Porcupine and Hyrum reservoirs) and the Logan River. A claimant with no decreed right on its paths that draws on a reservoir of a system ranks after every decreed right of that system (PRIOR-LEX) or first (PRIOR-LEX storage shared). A claimant whose rights are not in the Utah layer and that draws on no Utah reservoir is alone in its system and ranks first. Tier k holds the claimants of rank k of every system; inside a tier the allocation is the leximin of CTI-RLex.
